description: Is a Roblox game idea already taken? Pass a short idea (80 characters at most, for example "steal a pet"): returns how many Roblox games already use that formula, how many studios, players online, how many launched in the last 30 days, the leader, the 5 top games, a verdict (wide_open, room_to_twist, one_leader or saturated, with its reason), the nearest ranked niche and the nearest open niche, plus a link to the same check on wieldr.app. Needs a free Wieldr account (a key, or signing in to the connector): without one the call is refused. Same checker and same daily limit as the Wieldr site: a free account has 10 checks per 24 h (re-checking an idea already checked costs nothing); paid plans have no limit. It measures how crowded a formula is, never whether a game will succeed. Roblox only. Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.

idea.description: The game idea in a few words, e.g. "steal a pet", "tower defense with pets".
